messages:
Anita: Quick sync — we need to lock launch commitments for the Console observability slice (dash + cost breakdown + lightweight tracing hooks). Customers expect cost SLOs before GA :eyes:
Marco: Agreed. Two big tradeoffs: sampling depth for traces (full vs p95 only) and whether cost breakdown is token-level or route-level. Both affect perf and storage costs.
Priya: Customer ask from FinOps pilot: route-level cost per model + per-route 90/95 latency buckets. Token-level breakdown is nice-to-have, not must for launch.
Sam: For tracing hooks, can we ship with sampled traces + synthetic trace capture for regressions? That cuts storage and still gives debuggability.
Marco: That feels reasonable. Proposal: default sampling 1% + on-demand full capture for recent errors; enable higher sampling for Dedicated accounts via config.
Anita: Acceptance criteria idea (short):
- Dashboards: route-level cost, token estimates, 90/95 latency, error-rate by route
- Tracing hooks: sampled traces (1%) + on-demand capture flow from console
- Error analytics: automatic grouping + first-hit replay link
- Perf: UI latency <= 200ms on main dashboard queries
- Storage: bounded 30d for sampled traces, 90d for errors metadata
Priya: Add: include a clear fallback policy in docs for customers on limited capacity (e.g., degrade to p95-only charts).
Sam: Ops bot note: deploy-test showed 12% increase in DB writes when token-level cost enabled. Leaving token-level off by default makes sense.
ops-bot: [deployment] perf-check completed: query latency 180ms p50, 420ms p95 under load.
Marco: UX question — do we expose sampling slider in the console or hide it behind a feature flag? For self-serve customers it's useful, but it adds complexity to onboarding.
Priya: Let's surface a single knob: "Trace fidelity" with presets (Low / Medium / High) that map to sampling rates and retention. Docs explain cost implications.
Anita: Roadmap priority: ship minimal dashboards + cost per-route + sampled traces (Low) for 1.0. Follow-up M1: token-level cost + trace fidelity presets + tracing UI drilldown.
Sam: Can we get a quick acceptance checklist in GH so eng/release can sign off? I'll stub a PR with the checklist and sample queries.
Anita: Thanks — I'll own stakeholder comms. Action items: @Marco draft sampling config RFC by EOD, @Priya write customer-facing doc blurb, @Sam create GH acceptance checklist. We'll reconvene tomorrow 9am to lock commit. :thumbsup:
